must.item: Water bottle is main subject and fully visible

must.why: Body is matte black with soft sheen; steel cap is metallic but the body is matte.
White marble with grey veins in the foreground; the bottle sits on it.
Diffuse light, soft faint shadow, no harsh glare.

faults.what: Marble covers only the bottom quarter of the frame, so it is less prominent.
Bottle's lower edge looks slightly flat, with a faint reflection; the metal cap was not requested but is plausible.

summary: A clean square product shot of a matte black bottle with a steel cap on veined white marble under soft light, with only minor composition limits.
